= Table alignment

.Default left alignment
[width=45%]
|===
|Default left |A wider second cell
|===

.Explicit center alignment
[align=center,width=45%]
|===
|Explicit center |A wider second cell
|===

.Explicit right alignment
[align=right,width=45%]
|===
|Explicit right |A wider second cell
|===

.Role attribute alignment
[role=center,width=45%]
|===
|Role attribute |A wider second cell
|===

.Alignment attribute takes precedence over role
[.right,align=left,width=45%]
|===
|Attribute left |A wider second cell
|===

.Invalid alignment falls through to role
[.right,align=invalid,width=45%]
|===
|Fallback right |A wider second cell
|===

.Blank alignment falls through to role
[.center,align=,width=45%]
|===
|Fallback center |A wider second cell
|===

.Alignment values are case-sensitive
[.center,align=RIGHT,width=45%]
|===
|Case fallback center |A wider second cell
|===

.Last valid alignment role wins
[.left.center.right,width=45%]
|===
|Last role right |A wider second cell
|===

.Float attribute does not float in print
[float=right,width=45%]
|===
|Float ignored |A wider second cell
|===

.Float-style role does not float in print
[.float-right,width=45%]
|===
|Float role ignored |A wider second cell
|===

.Centered content-sized autowidth
[%autowidth,align=center]
|===
|Auto |Width
|===

.Right-aligned content-sized autowidth
[.right%autowidth]
|===
|Auto |Width
|===

.Full-width alignment has no visible effect
[align=right,width=100%]
|===
|Full |Width
|===
